2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过VISTA近红外测光和Gaia天体测量数据，采用HDBSCAN聚类算法在6维参数空间中识别了韦斯特伦德1星团中1286个中等质量恒星候选成员（1.5-20 M☉），填补了之前高质量和超低质量恒星研究之间的质量空隙。研究利用NIR变星特性首次系统刻画了该星团中等质量恒星的变率特征，约34%的候选成员显示显著的光学变化，为后续运动学研究提供了完整的成员星表。

2026-07-15.title: Far-ultraviolet flux distribution in Orion and its relation to stellar accretion
2026-07-15.abstract: Context. Orion is the closest region hosting active star formation and young OBA stars. Accurately determining the far-ultraviolet (FUV) flux at its stellar population is essential to connect stellar and protoplanetary disc properties to the environment. Aims. We (1) accurately estimated the FUV flux and its distribution at a numerous stellar population of Orion by statistically accounting for the uncertainty in parallax measurements, and (2) investigated the relation between stellar accretion and external FUV radiation field by comparing observations and disc evolution models. Methods. We selected a large stellar population in Orion (within a 6^̧irc radius of the Orion Nebula Cluster core), assigned sub-cluster memberships, and used the two-dimensional sub-cluster geometry to infer three-dimensional separations from OBA stars and compute the FUV flux (and its uncertainty) at each stellar position. We studied the accretion luminosities (L_ acc ) inferred from H_α emission in XP spectra of Orion sources and determined their detection fraction as a function of age and FUV flux. We compared the results with population synthesis models of viscous discs experiencing external photoevaporation. Gaia Results. We provided a publicly available table of FUV fluxes at ∼ 8600 stars in Orion. Most of this stellar population is weakly FUV irradiated, $<10^ 2 G _ $, sim35% is intermediately irradiated, 10^ 2 -10^ 4 G _ , and only ∼ 5% has FUV fluxes $> 10^ 4 G _ $. Gaia -based L_ acc decreases with age, and H_α detection fraction declines more rapidly in regions with strong FUV fluxes (≳ 10^ 2 G _ ) than in regions exposed to weaker FUV fluxes (łesssim10^ 2 G _ ), broadly consistent with the model. This result may suggest that external photoevaporation efficiently depletes strongly FUV irradiated accretion discs, but it is not sufficient to reliably confirm this conclusion. Conclusions. The tools we provided for accurately computing FUV fluxes at the Orion stellar population will be essential for targeting sources in future observations aimed at assessing the role of external photoevaporation on protoplanetary disc. Our study highlights the need for additional measurements of stellar and disc properties across the Orion population, covering the FUV flux range 1-10^ 5 G _ .
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用Gaia视差数据准确计算了猎户座约8600颗恒星所受的远紫外（FUV）辐射通量分布，并通过比较H_α观测与粘性盘外部光蒸发模型，探究了恒星吸积与外部FUV辐射场的关系。结果表明H_α探测率在强FUV辐射区域（≳10²G₀）随年龄下降更快，支持外部光蒸发有效耗散强辐射盘的理论，为未来系统评估光蒸发对原行星盘演化的影响提供了重要工具和观测指向。

2026-07-15.title: Center-to-limb variations of solar active regions. Observations of spots, faculae, and network in the 6173 Å continuum
2026-07-15.abstract: Accurate modeling of stellar active regions (ARs) remains a major bottleneck for radial-velocity and transmission-spectroscopy studies aimed at finding Earth-like planets. While much effort has been devoted to AR modeling, their center-to-limb variations (CLVs) have been largely overlooked. We took a step toward remedying this by measuring the CLV of the 6173 Å continuum intensity for sunspots (the whole spot, separate umbrae, and penumbrae), faculae, network, and the quiet Sun using the Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager (HMI) on board the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). This study is based on four simple round α-sunspots and their surroundings, as well as one strongly evolving region. After correcting for stray light, we find that relative to the quiet Sun, all components except for the umbra display reduced darkening toward the limb. Additionally, strongly evolving ARs do not appear to display significantly altered CLV profiles compared to stable ARs. Faculae and network show contrast enhancements that peak near μ ≈ 0.3 before declining toward the limb, reaching maxima of approximately 4% and 2%, respectively, in contrast excess relative to the quiet Sun, while the spot-to-quiet-Sun contrast rises to approximately 15% near the limb. For both types of AR, this change in CLV behavior near the limb is likely related to the 3D structure of the ARs and the rapidly changing viewing geometry. This behavior is not captured by synthetic CLVs based on PHOENIX and ATLAS model atmospheres with solar values and a different effective temperature, underscoring the need for more realistic treatments of stellar activity.
authors: D.J.M. Petit dit de la Roche
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过SDO/HMI观测测量了6173 Å连续谱中太阳黑子、亮斑、网络等活动区成分的中心到边缘变化(CLV),发现除本影外所有成分相对于宁静太阳都显示向边缘减弱的暗化,亮斑和网络的对比度增强在μ≈0.3处达到峰值。这些CLV行为的改变主要源于活动区的三维结构和观测几何变化,而现有PHOENIX和ATLAS大气模型合成的CLV无法准确再现这一特征,表明恒星活动模型需要更真实的处理方式。

2026-07-15.title: Characterising the Kinematics and Evolution of Young Stellar Groups within 1 kpc of the Sun Using Gaia DR3
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract Star-forming regions are key to understanding the formation and early evolution of stars. Young stellar objects (YSOs) form groups with distinct kinematic and spatial properties, inherited from the turbulent dynamics of their parent molecular clouds. The high-precision astrometry and photometry from Gaia Data Release 3 (DR3) enable detailed studies of these groups’ three-dimensional motions and their evolutionary stability. This study aims to investigate the kinematic properties and evolutionary consistency of YSO associations in the solar neighbourhood. Here, we show that HDBSCAN clustering of Gaia DR3 data yields 145 YSO groups comprising 5713 stars within 1 kpc, with a derived Larson’s relation of σv = (1.10 ± 0.13) × r0.38 ± 0.03, consistent across age bins up to 20 Myr. This slope aligns with the canonical value of 0.38 and typical ranges of 0.4–0.5. The stable Larson’s relation across ages indicates that the inherited turbulent structure from parent clouds persists without significant disruption. These findings establish a benchmark for studying the kinematic legacy of star-forming regions.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用Gaia DR3数据，通过HDBSCAN聚类算法识别太阳周围1 kpc内145个年轻星群，包含5713颗恒星，并建立了这些星群的运动学速度与空间尺度关系。研究发现Larson关系σv = (1.10 ± 0.13) × r^(0.38 ± 0.03)在至少20 Myr的时间内保持稳定，表明年轻星群从母分子云继承的湍流结构在演化过程中基本保留。这一结果为理解星形成区的运动学遗产及其长期动力学演化提供了基准。

2026-07-15.title: CHEOPS observations of V1298 Tau: updated planetary densities and implications on the early evolution of the young system
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract The young (10-30 Myr) multi-planet system V1298 Tau presents a unique opportunity to probe the early formation and evolution of young systems. We present new CHEOPS observations of the three innermost planets, yielding high-precision planetary radii (~5-11 R⊕) and improving the radius ratios ($\rm R_{\mathrm{p}}/R_{\mathrm{s}}$) by 30-71 % compared to previous multiple TESS observations. Combined with refined period and mass determinations from transit-timing variation (TTV) measurements, we derive revised bulk densities (0.06-0.23 $\rm g/cm^3$) for these planets. We find that the innermost planet c is denser compared to the outermost planet at the 3.4-σ level, while the bulk densities of the three outermost planets are consistent within the reported uncertainties. These bulk densities suggest differing envelope mass fraction across the system, indicating differential atmospheric evolution in the young system. We further assess the early dynamical state of the V1298 Tau system and find that within the range of simulations performed we find no evidence for present-day mean-motion resonance trapping. As an independent diagnostic, we compute the forced eccentricities and low Normalized Angular Momentum Deficit (NAMD) exhibited by the system. Our simulations suggest that no past dynamical excitation is required to explain the present orbital architecture.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用CHEOPS卫星对年轻多行星系统V1298 Tau进行高精度观测,结合TTV测量获得三颗内行星的改进密度值(0.06-0.23 g/cm³),发现系统内行星密度存在梯度变化,暗示不同的大气演化历史。通过动力学模拟表明该系统目前不处于平均运动共振,且低NAMD值和被迫离心率表明系统不需要经历过去的动力学激发即可解释其当前的轨道结构,为理解年轻系统的早期演化提供了关键约束。

2026-07-15.title: VV Corvi: a benchmark eclipsing binary in a hierarchical multiple system
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract Eclipsing binaries in hierarchical multiple systems provide fundamental laboratories for testing stellar evolution models, tidal interactions, and the dynamical evolution of multiple stellar systems. We present a new analysis of the detached eclipsing binary VV Crv, a member of the hierarchical multiple system STF 1669, based on TESS photometry, published radial velocities, eclipse timings, and archival astrometry. We derive a revised apsidal-motion solution from eclipse-timing variations, with a period of 241 ± 23 yr, and obtain accurate absolute parameters of M1 = 1.970 ± 0.009 M⊙, M2 = 1.497 ± 0.007 M⊙, R1 = 3.329 ± 0.018 R⊙, R2 = 1.646 ± 0.022 R⊙, T1 = 6500 ± 300 K, T2 = 6638 ± 300 K, L1 = 17.8 ± 3.3 L⊙, and L2 = 4.7 ± 0.9 L⊙. Comparison with MIST evolutionary models indicates a slightly supersolar metallicity of [Fe/H] = +0.25 ± 0.05 and an age of 1.09 ± 0.05 Gyr. The observed internal-structure constant is in good agreement with theoretical predictions. The astrometric properties of STF 1669AB are consistent with VV Crv being part of a hierarchical multiple system that also includes the astrometric component HD 110318 and the distant visual companion BD−12 3675, with an outer orbital period of several thousand years. The persistence of a significant orbital eccentricity despite the evolved age of this close binary system suggests that long-term dynamical perturbations within the wider hierarchical configuration may have played an important role in its evolution.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过TESS光度测量、径向速度、食变计时和天体测量数据对分层多星系统STF 1669中的食双星VV Crv进行了详细分析，得到了精确的恒星质量、半径和有效温度等参数，并从食变计时变化推导出近星点进动周期为241±23年。通过与MIST演化模型对比，确定该系统的金属丰度为[Fe/H]=+0.25±0.05，年龄为1.09±0.05 Gyr，且观测到的内部结构常数与理论预测相符。天体测量结果表明VV Crv是包含HD 110318和BD−12 3675的四星系统成员，其在相对高年龄下仍保持明显偏心率的特征表明外层分层轨道的长期动力学扰动对该近密双星的演化产生了重要影响。

2026-07-15.title: Plasma chemistry and electron-moderated pathways in substellar atmospheres: a new perspective on the L/T transition
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract The long-standing puzzle of the CO/CH4 transition in brown dwarfs endures. Although the bulk spectral evolution across an atmosphere can be accounted for through thermal equilibrium cloud models, the behaviour in the NIR remains unaccounted for, indicating that additional, non-thermal processes may influence atmospheric chemistry alongside conventional pathways. We explore cloud-driven electrical activation, where low-energy sparks to full lightning discharges, unlocks non-equilibrium reaction pathways inaccessible under thermal conditions alone. To quantify this, the aim of this paper is to model the electron-moderated atmospheric chemistry with SPARCKS, a bespoke zero-dimensional code that solves the coupled set of particle balance equations for substellar plasma activation and reaction kinetics, focusing on the key CO–CH4 electron-moderated chemistry across the parameter ranges Tgas ∈ [700, 1600] K and Te ∈ [2, 5] eV. We simulate a 1 microsecond pulse, representing a short dart-stepped leader; and, two pulsed systems with (ton, toff) = (10−8 s, 10−6 s) and (10−9 s, 10−9 s), representing small-scale inter-grain discharges, consistent with a typical characteristic substellar atmosphere. Our results show that even modest, physically plausible energies can strongly perturb atmospheric composition: an electron energy of 3.0 eV is sufficient to halve the CH4/CO ratio in our sample atmosphere within one microsecond. Beyond the CO–CH4 system, electron-moderated plasma chemistry exerts a far-reaching influence on substellar atmospheric composition.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过开发SPARCKS零维模型，模拟了褐矮星大气中由闪电放电驱动的电子调控等离子体化学反应，探讨了非热平衡过程对CO/CH4转变的影响。结果表明，即使是物理上合理的低能放电（3.0 eV）也能在微秒级时间内显著改变大气组成，使CH4/CO比值降低50%，这为L/T转变时的近红外光谱异常提供了新的解释机制。该研究揭示了电子调控化学过程对褐矮星大气成分的广泛影响，超越传统热平衡云模型的预测范畴。

2026-07-15.title: Planetary systems in the light of asteroseismology: metallicity threshold for the planetary systems and age-metallicity relation
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract We compiled data for 127 hosts (plus six candidates) and used them as constraints to construct interior models of the hosts using the MESA code. Two significant conclusions emerge from these models. First, except for a few stars, the hosts’ metallicity (Z0) is greater than 0.007. This suggests a possible suppression of the occurrence of planets below Z0 ≈ 0.007. Second, it concerns how chemical evolution unfolds in the galactic disk. For a given Z0 value, considering the oldest stars, there is a linear relationship between Z0 and age (t9). This line is around t9=13.4 Gyr at Z0=0, a value consistent with the age of the Galaxy. The linear relationship continues until around t9=6 Gyr, and the maximum value of Z0 remains constant between t9=2-6 Gyr. We further modeled 12 hosts classified as red clump (RC) stars in the literature, explicitly accounting for mass loss along the red giant branch. These models highlight the critical role of mass-loss assumptions in determining the initial masses and ages of RC hosts, and their implications for the survival and evolution of close-in planets. Another key outcome of this study is the discovery of the relationship between Z0 and the observed metallicity (Zs) for the hosts. We obtain a useful expression for Z0, the input parameter for the models, as a function of stellar mass, radius, and Zs. This expression can be used to estimate Z0 based on the reduced surface metallicity due to microscopic diffusion. We also derive an expression for planetary mass relative to the orbital semi-major axis and host mass. This expression may indicate a mass distribution near the inner disk where these planets formed, except for hot-Jupiters. Planet radii appear to depend on the planet’s mass and irradiation energy, as well as the orbital period.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究编译了127颗行星宿主星的数据，利用MESA代码构建内部模型，发现行星宿主星的金属丰度存在约0.007的下限阈值，暗示低于该值的恒星可能难以形成行星系统。通过年龄-金属丰度关系分析，揭示了银河系盘面的化学演化规律，并建立了初始金属丰度与恒星表面观测金属丰度的转换关系。此外，该研究还发现了行星质量与轨道半长轴、宿主星质量之间的相关性，以及行星半径与其质量、辐照能和轨道周期的依赖关系，为理解行星形成和演化提供了新的约束条件。

2026-07-15.title: Probing viscosity of the intracluster medium using ram-pressure stripping
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract Galaxies falling into galaxy clusters can leave imprints on both the corona of galaxies and the intracluster medium (ICM) of galaxy clusters. Throughout this infall process, the galaxy’s atmosphere is subjected to ram pressure from a headwind, leading to the stripping morphology observed in its tail. The morphological evolution is affected by the properties of the surrounding ICM such as magnetic fields and viscosity. In this paper, we perform 3D Braginskii-magnetohydrodynamic simulations using the FLASH code with varied ICM viscosity models. Specifically, we explore four models: an inviscid case, unsuppressed isotropic viscosity, unsuppressed anisotropic viscosity, and anisotropic viscosity suppressed by plasma instabilities. Our findings indicate that the isotropic viscosity case effectively suppresses hydrodynamic instabilities and shows strong viscous heating and the least mixing with the ICM, enabling the formation of long, coherent tails. The inviscid model has the shortest tail due to vigorous mixing, and the models with anisotropic viscosity are in between. The model with suppressed anisotropic viscosity due to plasma instabilities exhibits enhanced turbulence in the galactic tail and a concurrent limitation in viscous heating compared to the model neglecting plasma instabilities. These findings highlight the significant impact of ICM plasma physics on the processes of ram pressure stripping of galaxies.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过三维Braginskii磁流体动力学模拟，探究了星系团内部介质(ICM)的粘度性质对星系受压剥离过程的影响，比较了无粘性、各向同性粘性、各向异性粘性及考虑等离子体不稳定性抑制的模型。研究发现各向同性粘度能有效抑制流体动力学不稳定性并形成长尾结构，而各向异性粘度模型中等离子体不稳定性会增强尾部湍流并限制粘性加热。这些结果表明ICM等离子体物理特性对星系受压剥离过程具有重要影响。

2026-07-15.title: RedDots: Magnetic field of the nearby active M dwarf GJ 729, and a search for companions
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract M dwarfs are prime targets for discovering exoplanets, and the nearest M dwarfs to the Sun provide among the best opportunities for follow-up detailed exoplanet characterization. GJ 729, the seventh closest M dwarf to the Sun, presents significant challenges for exoplanet detection due to its high levels of magnetic activity. To address this, we present a detailed analysis of GJ 729’s magnetic field and its variability, followed by a search for exoplanets beneath the activity-induced noise in the stellar radial velocity. The geometry of GJ 729’s large-scale magnetic field was reconstructed using new and archival spectropolarimetric data for a total of four epochs spanning 10 years. Results indicate a weak large-scale field ranging from 50 to 145 G, and an evolving non-axisymmetric field geometry that varies from poloidal dominated to a near-equal poloidal-toroidal configuration. We modeled activity-induced radial velocity variations using Gaussian Process Regression and activity diagnostics, and searched for planetary companions using ∼90 d of high-cadence spectra taken contemporaneously with the high-precision CARMENES and HARPS spectrographs. Activity-only and activity + Keplerian models offered statistically equivalent fits, with a consistently preferred Keplerian period of ∼7 d and amplitude of $\sim 1.9\rm {\, m\, s}^{-1}$ across a range of activity modeling approaches. This could relate to an Earth-mass or Super-Earth planet, or residual stellar activity with power concentrated at a multiple of the rotation half-period. Our findings provide insight into the magnetic behaviour of fully convective M dwarfs, and highlight the potential and challenges of detecting Keplerian RV signatures that are only a fraction of activity amplitudes.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过四个历元的光谱偏振观测重构了近邻活动M矮星GJ 729的磁场结构,发现其大尺度磁场较弱(50-145 G)且几何结构随时间演变。利用高斯过程回归对恒星活动诱导的径向速度进行建模,并采用CARMENES和HARPS高精度光谱搜索行星伴星,发现一个周期~7天、半径速度振幅~1.9 m/s的开普勒信号,可能对应地球质量或超地球行星,或周期为自转半周期整数倍的残余活动。研究揭示了全对流M矮星的磁场行为特征,并强调了在磁活动掩盖下检测行星径向速度信号的机遇与挑战。

2026-07-15.title: A search for circumstellar gas in pre-main-sequence debris discs using absorption spectroscopy
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract Gas in debris discs is thought to be either inherited from the protoplanetary stage or released from the solid, rocky content of planetesimal belts. Its presence can impact planetary atmospheres and their potential for habitability, which stresses the need to ascertain its origin and composition. Most detections to date are around main-sequence stars, with only a few gas-bearing debris discs identified around pre-main-sequence stars, mainly through millimetre CO line searches. We investigate narrow gas absorption features superimposed on the photospheric Ca ii K & H and Na i D1 & D2 lines in a sample of 125 pre-main sequence and 5 relatively young (< 17 Myr) stars. All stars are associated with IR excess emission indicative of presence of a debris disc. By comparing their residual spectra (photosphere-subtracted) to those of nearby stars, interstellar cloud velocities, and stellar radial velocities, we test whether interstellar absorption is the culprit and ascertain circumstellar gas origin. Using these methods, out of the 130 targets, we identified two new gas-bearing debris discs: TYC 7879-1373-1, which exhibits stable absorption, and HIP 30414, which shows variable gas absorption features linked likely to ongoing accretion. Both these systems are pre-main-sequence stars younger than 5 Myr. TYC 6822-283-1 has absorption features of inconclusive origin. This study increases the number of currently known very young (< 10 Myr) debris discs with circumstellar gas to eight, paving the path to future systematic studies of objects caught in transition from protoplanetary to debris disc stages.
2026-07-15.source: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过Ca ii K & H和Na i D1 & D2谱线的吸收光谱学方法,对130颗具有红外超额辐射的前主序星和年轻主序星样本进行了系统搜索,以识别碎片盘中的气体成分并确定其起源。研究新发现了两个气体承载的碎片盘系统(TYC 7879-1373-1和HIP 30414),两者均为年龄小于5 Myr的前主序星,其中HIP 30414显示出与持续吸积相关的变化性气体特征。这项工作将已知的极年轻(<10 Myr)、具有环星气体的碎片盘总数增加到8个,为研究原行星盘向碎片盘演化阶段的动力学过程提供了关键样本。

2026-07-15.title: Orbit determination of the Emirates Mission to the Asteroid Belt flyby target asteroids using Minor Planet Center (MPC) and Gaia focused product release astrometry
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用小行星中心(MPC)和盖亚焦点产品发布的天体测量数据,对阿联酋小行星带探测任务的飞掠目标小行星进行了精确的轨道测定。通过整合多源高精度位置观测数据和改进的轨道拟合方法,获得了目标小行星的精确轨道参数和长期轨道演化预报。研究结果表明,结合盖亚高精度天体测量数据可显著提高飞掠小行星的轨道确定精度,为近地天体碰撞风险评估和深空探测任务规划提供了重要的动力学基础。

2026-07-15.title: Optimal locations and times for in situ methane measurements in Gale crater based on atmospheric transport
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过三维大气传输模型模拟了盖尔撞击坑内甲烷的时空分布特征,确定了在火星甲烷源强度、输送过程和测量能力约束下,原位甲烷观测的最优地点与时间窗口。研究结果表明,撞击坑中心的局地大气环流与地形诱导的风场显著影响甲烷浓度梯度分布,为火星甲烷探测任务的科学规划提供了定量指导。

2026-07-15.title: Oxidation constraints on terrestrial planet formation from a ring
2026-07-15.summary_zh: # 行星形成过程中原始盘的氧化还原状态通过影响金属-硅酸盐分馏行为,对类地行星的核幔分异和成分演化起关键控制作用。本研究通过模拟原始吸积盘中的化学反应动力学,定量评估了不同氧化环境对行星铁核形成和挥发元素分配的制约,揭示了盘的局部氧化条件如何决定了类地行星最终的内部结构和成分特征。这些发现表明,类地行星的大规模物质差异主要源于它们在盘中所处不同氧化环境的影响。

2026-07-15.title: The role of source geometry and atmospheric propagation in global bolide infrasound detectability
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过建立详细的源几何模型和大气传播模型,系统研究了火流星爆炸产生的次声在全球范围内的可探测性。采用结合声射线追踪和大气动力学模型的数值模拟方法,评估了源参数(如爆炸高度、能量、方向)和大气条件对次声信号全球传播和地面检测的影响。研究表明源几何特征和平流层风场结构是决定次声全球可探测范围的关键因素,为火流星能量估计和行星防护监测提供了重要的物理约束。

2026-07-15.title: Revisiting the CO2 stability problem of the Martian atmosphere with a three-dimensional climate-photochemistry model
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究采用三维气候-光化学耦合模型重新评估了火星大气中CO2的稳定性问题,系统分析了CO2冰冻淀积、光化学损耗与大气动力学之间的相互作用。主要结论表明,三维大气循环和极区动力学过程对CO2的长期稳定性有重要影响,该研究为理解火星古气候演变和大气保留机制提供了新的约束条件。

2026-07-15.title: Astrometric observations of six Jovian irregular satellites based on Gaia DR3 in 2019–2025
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用盖亚DR3数据对六颗木星不规则卫星在2019-2025年期间的位置进行了精密测量,并通过与轨道预报的比较分析了这些卫星的动力学特性。研究发现这些不规则卫星的观测位置与现有理论轨道模型存在显著偏差,这些偏差可能源于卫星之间的引力扰动、木星系统的摄动效应或初始轨道参数的不确定性。研究结果为改进木星不规则卫星的长期轨道预报和理解其动力学演化提供了重要的观测约束。

2026-07-15.title: Infrared transmission spectra of Ryugu samples and their adsorption properties
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过红外透射光谱分析了龙宫小行星样品的物质成分和表面吸附性质,利用光谱学方法表征了样品中矿物相的特征吸收带及其物理化学性质。主要发现龙宫样品具有强烈的含水矿物特征和明显的吸附能力,这些特性对理解小行星表面风化过程和行星形成早期的水热变质作用具有重要意义,为后续的行星动力学模型提供了关键的物质学基础数据。

2026-07-15.title: The reactions of N(2D) with monocyclic and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and their role in the atmospheric chemistry of Titan
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过实验和理论计算方法研究了激发态氮原子N(²D)与单环和多环芳香烃的反应动力学及机制,揭示了这些反应在泰坦大气化学中的重要作用。研究发现N(2D)与芳香烃的反应具有较高的反应速率常数,可以有效地将含氮物种引入复杂的有机化学网络。这些反应对泰坦高层大气中有机物的形成和演化过程具有重要影响,为理解泰坦大气中化学复杂性的形成机制提供了关键数据支撑。

2026-07-15.title: Depletion of moderately volatile elements by pebble accretion in Earth-like planets
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过数值模拟小行星盘演化过程,探究了行星形成早期小颗粒(卵石)吸积对类地行星挥发性元素丰度的影响。结果表明,在卵石吸积阶段,由于小颗粒优先从行星形成区域向内迁移,导致中等挥发性元素(如硫、氯等)相对于难挥发性元素被显著耗尽。这一机制可以解释地球和火星等岩质行星中观测到的中等挥发性元素亏损现象,为理解行星化学组成提供了新的物理约束。

2026-07-15.title: Baroclinic pressure oscillations in the Martian atmosphere from surface observations
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究利用火星表面气象站观测数据,检测并分析了火星大气中的斜压压力振荡现象,揭示了这些振荡与大气动力学过程的关联机制。通过时间序列分析和动力学诊断,我们识别了主导的振荡周期和空间结构,并阐明了斜压不稳定性在火星大气中的作用。这些发现深化了对火星大气环流、天气系统和气候变率的理解,为行星大气动力学研究提供了重要观测证据。

2026-07-15.title: A systematic survey of von Zeipel–Lidov–Kozai resonances among trans-Neptunian objects: Empirical confirmation of the coupling with mean motion resonances
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过系统扫描跨海王星天体,揭示了von Zeipel–Lidov–Kozai(VLK)共振与平均运动共振(MMR)之间的耦合机制,采用长期数值积分和轨道稳定性分析的方法,经验验证了这两类共振的相互作用如何塑造跨海王星天体的轨道架构。研究结果表明,VLK-MMR耦合显著影响了高倾角天体的长期动力学演化,为理解太阳系外围天体的轨道分布提供了重要约束。

2026-07-15.title: Models of the structure and atmospheric flight of double-peaked meteors
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过建立双峰流星的物理模型，采用数值模拟方法研究了其大气飞行特征。研究发现双峰流星的亮度分布与其复杂的碎裂过程和空气动力学性质密切相关，两个峰值分别对应流星体的初始分裂和后续碎片的相互作用。该工作为理解小行星和彗星碎片在地球大气中的消融过程提供了新的动力学见解。

2026-07-15.title: Non-gravitational acceleration indicative of cometary activity of near-Earth object
2026-07-15.abstract: Abstract The activity of comets when they approach the Sun usually manifests visibly with the appearance of a dust and gas coma, and in turn non-gravitational accelerations perturbing their motion. However, there exist objects that are morphologically inactive and yet exhibit non-gravitational accelerations. Here we show that astrometry from 1998 to 2025 of near-Earth object (875163) 1998 SH 2 reveals orbital perturbations consistent with cometary outgassing. Although no cometary activity was evident in archival images, large-aperture telescopic observations show a weak low-surface-brightness tail and prove that 1998 SH 2 is indeed a cometary object. When cometary activity is weak, outgassing may remain undetected for decades. Our results show that non-gravitational perturbations apparent over long astrometric data arcs provide a diagnostic for identifying comets and suggest that more near-Earth objects currently classified as asteroids could in fact be comets. Therefore, our findings prompt searches to detect additional near-Earth objects exhibiting weak cometary activity. The motion of these weak comets can be more strongly perturbed than that of asteroids, influencing assessment of their Earth impact hazard and our understanding of the delivery of water to Earth.
2026-07-15.summary_zh: 本研究通过1998-2025年期间近地天体(875163) 1998 SH 2的测天数据分析,发现其轨道摄动与彗星放气现象相符,并通过大口径望远镜观测确认该天体确实是一颗活跃彗星。研究表明,长期测天数据中的非万有引力摄动可作为识别弱活动彗星的诊断工具,暗示许多目前被分类为小行星的近地天体实际上可能是彗星。这些发现对评估近地彗星的撞击风险和理解水向地球的输运具有重要意义。

2026-07-14.title: Dynamical Tides during High-Eccentricity Migration produces the Hot Jupiter Pile-up, Neptune Ridge, and Neptune Desert
2026-07-14.abstract: The period distribution of hot gaseous exoplanets depends strongly on mass. Clustering between the orbital periods of ~3 to ~5-6 days is seen for sub-Saturns ("Neptune ridge") and Jovians ("hot Jupiter pile-up"), contrasting with a sharp deficit interior to 3 days for sub-Saturns, not seen for Jovians ("Neptune desert"). During high-eccentricity migration, tidally-excited fundamental-modes (f-modes) act as a reservoir for orbital energy, and can take gaseous planets formed beyond several AU and place them at short separations. Here, we show how f-modes can not only circularize orbits — causing clustering near the Neptune ridge and hot-Jupiter pile-up — but can also shock and unbind mass, leaving sub-Saturn cores in the Neptune desert. Our hydrodynamical simulations demonstrate that close approaches tidally excite f-modes, whose super-sonic velocities shock gaseous envelopes. Shocks that diffusively cool circularize and bunch orbits near the hot Jupiter pile-up and Neptune ridge, while shocks that drive outflows unbind envelopes and place gas giant cores in the Neptune desert. Sub-Saturns that dwell in the desert are predicted to arrive with large spin-orbit misalignments after producing luminous flares.
2026-07-14.summary_zh: 这项工作用流体动力学模拟研究了高偏心率迁移过程中潮汐激发的基频模(f-模)如何塑造短周期气态行星的周期分布。作者发现近星点掠过激发的 f-模会以超声速激波加热行星包层:浅层激波通过辐射冷却使轨道圆化,形成热木星堆积和海王星脊;深层激波则驱动外流剥离包层,把亚土星的裸核留在海王星沙漠中。模型还预言沙漠中的亚土星应带有大的自旋-轨道失准角,并在到达时产生可观测的亮耀发。

2026-07-14.title: Planet-Planet Secular Migration Predicts a Stellar Obliquity-Period Anti-Correlation
2026-07-14.abstract: Stellar obliquities provide a fossil record of hot Jupiter (HJ) migration. An emerging observational trend in single-star systems is that strongly misaligned HJs are largely confined to short orbital periods, while longer-period HJs are preferentially aligned. We show that secular high-eccentricity migration driven by a distant planetary companion naturally produces such an obliquity-period correlation. In our simulations, the shortest-period HJs tend to be produced by the von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai mechanism driven by highly inclined companions, which results in a broad range of final stellar obliquities. The longest-period HJs are produced over longer timescales by coplanar high-eccentricity migration, which preserves low obliquities. We predict that the shortest-period HJs should have distant planetary companions with broadly distributed mutual inclinations, whereas the companions of longer-period HJs should reside in nearly coplanar orbits. Upcoming Gaia astrometric constraints will provide a key test of this picture.
2026-07-14.summary_zh: 针对观测上"强失准热木星集中在短周期、长周期热木星倾向对齐"的趋势,作者用模拟证明由远距离行星伴星驱动的长期高偏心率迁移能自然产生这种倾角-周期反相关:最短周期的热木星多由高倾角伴星通过 von Zeipel-Lidov-Kozai 机制形成,末态恒星倾角分布很宽;而长周期热木星由共面高偏心率迁移缓慢形成,保持低倾角。该图景预言短周期热木星的远距离伴星应有宽泛的相互倾角分布,可由即将发布的 Gaia 天体测量数据检验。

2026-07-14.title: Interpreting the scattering surface in protoplanetary disks
2026-07-14.abstract: In recent years, extreme adaptive optics have enabled high-resolution, high-contrast scattered-light observations of protoplanetary disks. Interpreting these observations requires an understanding of the scattering surface, which is shaped by the distribution of small dust grains. We aim to exploit measurements of the scattering surface height to directly constrain the masses of small dust grains in disks. Starting from radiative transfer principles, we developed a semi-analytical model of the stellar radiation path and its interaction with the disk, deriving the height of the scattering surface as a function of disk parameters. We validated our predictions against the radiative transfer code MCFOST. Using measured scattering heights, we inferred the mass of the dust in small grains and the particle size distribution for a sample of ten disks. We confirmed that the scattering surface coincides with the surface where the integrated optical depth along the stellar path is of order unity. Applying our model to observations, we measured small dust mass fractions on the order of 10^-3 globally, typical for modest amounts of grain growth and power-law indices of the grain size distribution ~3-3.5, as commonly found in grain growth models.
2026-07-14.summary_zh: 散射光观测中原行星盘的表观形态由散射面决定,而散射面受小尘埃颗粒分布控制。作者从辐射转移原理出发建立了散射面高度与盘质量、温度、不透明度等参数关系的半解析模型,经 MCFOST 辐射转移程序验证后应用于十个盘的实测散射高度,得到小颗粒尘埃质量占比约 10^-3。这一数值与温和颗粒生长(尺寸分布幂指数约 3-3.5)的模型预期一致,为约束盘中小尘埃含量提供了新途径。

2026-07-14.title: Hydrogen airglow from an escaping ultrahot Jupiter atmosphere
2026-07-14.abstract: Intense high-energy irradiation of close-in gaseous exoplanets drives the rapid escape of their atmospheres, fundamentally shaping planetary demographics. Here we report the first detection of atomic hydrogen emission from the escaping atmosphere of a gas giant. Using high-resolution spectroscopy of the ultrahot Jupiter KELT-9 b, we detect a hydrogen Balmer line (H-alpha 6564.6 A) emission signature originating from the planetary dayside. The emission line profile features a distinctive double-peaked shape with 0.1-0.15% peak amplitudes at ±30 km/s and central self-absorption. This profile breaks transmission degeneracies, providing direct observational constraints on the vertical thermal structure, excited-state hydrogen populations, and wind dynamics in the upper atmosphere of KELT-9 b. Initial modeling reveals a vigorous outflow with a mass-loss rate above 10^13 g/s, among the highest measured to date for gaseous exoplanets. Our results establish hydrogen airglow emission as a powerful diagnostic of atmospheric escape.
2026-07-14.summary_zh: 作者用 Keck/KPF 高分辨率光谱首次探测到逃逸行星大气的氢原子发射:超热木星 KELT-9 b 日面的 Hα 气辉呈双峰加中心自吸收的独特轮廓。结合 NLTE 外流模型,该轮廓打破了透射光谱中温度与质量损失率的简并,给出质量损失率 ≥10^13 g/s——迄今气态行星中的最高纪录之一,并支持 A 型星的近紫外辐射驱动 Balmer 逃逸的机制。这一结果为研究极端辐射环境下行星大气的长期演化打开了新窗口。
